[ but cf S. prapātābhimukha], a steep cliff or precipice ; Vism 138, 23 (puriso ~-papātābhimukho dhāvanto … thātuṃ na sakkoti papāte eva patati, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce ~-taṭābhimukho); — ~-papātaṃ, ~-pātaṃ, adv. , falling as if cut down; ; Vin II 284, 15 (… kandanti ~-papātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti …, Ce, Ee so; Be ~-pātaṃ; Se ~-pādā va patanti; cf Sp-ṭ [ Be ] III 447, 10 foll. : chinnānaṃ pāto viya ~-pāto, taṃ ~-pātaṃ, bhāvanapuṃsakaniddeso ’yaṃ) ≠ D II 140, 5 ( Ee so; Be, Ce ~-pātaṃ; Se ~-pādaṃ viya; Sv 581, 3 foll. : majjhe chinnā viya hutvā yato vā tato vā patanti) ≠ Nidd-a I 75, 4 ( eds so ) = Vibh-a 105, 26 ( eds so ); Ja VI 303, 11 (~-ppapātaṃ patitvā, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se ~-pādā viya); — ~-pilotika, mfn. [ cf BHS chinnaplotika, -pilotika], revealed, uncovered ;? M I 141, 22 (dhammo uttāno vivaṭo pakāsito ~-pilotiko; cf Ps II 119, 19 foll. ); — ~-bhabbhara, ~-babbhara, mfn. , not making the sound bharabhara;? M I 128, 22 (biḷārabhastā … chinnasassarā ~-bhabbharā … ahaṃ imaṃ biḷārabhastaṃ … kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā … sarasaraṃ karissāmi bharabharaṃ karissāmī ti, Be so; Ce, Ee ~-babbharā; Se ~-pabbharā; Ps II 101, 33 : ~-bhabbharā ti ~-bhabbharasaddā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~-pabbharā ti ~-pabbharasaddā); — ~-mūlaka, mfn. , with its root(s) cut away ; A II 147, 31 (~-mūlako suttanto; Mp III 137, 21 : mūlabhūtānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ upacchinnattā ~-mulako, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ucchinnattā); Th 90 (pañcakkhandhā pariññātā tiṭṭhanti ~-mūlakā); Sv 226, 13 (~ā rukkhā viya); — ~-vaṭuma, mfn. , who has brought the path to an end; who has broken the cycle ; D II 8, 5 (tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce ~-vaṭume … jātito pi anussarissati …; Sv 425, 28 : ~-vaṭume ti ettha vaṭuman ti kusalākusalakammavaṭṭaṃ vuccati) ≠ M III 118, 17 ≠ S IV 52, 27 (Spk II 370, 28 : taṇhāvaṭumass’ eva chinnattā ~-vaṭume); — ~-vaṭumaka, m ( fn )., (one) who has brought the path to an end, who has broken the cycle ; Vism 410, 31 (~-vaṭumakānussaraṇādīsu) = Sp 158, 22 (Sp-ṭ [ Be ] I 388, 27 foll. : ~-vaṭumakā sammāsambuddhā … ~-vaṭumakā pana sabbe va anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbutā chinnasaṃsāramaggattā); Sv 410, 9 (~-vaṭumakānussaraṇaṃ); As 414, 29 (atīte buddhā maggaṃ bhāvayiṃsu phalaṃ sacchākaṃsu nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyiṃsū ti ~-vaṭumakānu-ssaraṇavasena maggaphalanibbānapaccavekkhaṇato); — ~-visāṇaka, mfn. , with horns cut off ; Spk III 223, 15* (usabho yathā ~-visāṇako); — ~-sassara, mfn. , not making the sound sarasara;? M I 128, 22 (biḷārabhastā … ~-sassarā chinnabhabbharā … ahaṃ imaṃ biḷārabhastaṃ … kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā sarasaraṃ karissāmi; Ps II 101, 32 : ~-sassarā ti ~-sassarasaddā); — ~-sota, mfn. [chinna + sota 2 ], who has crossed or cut off the stream, who has brought the flow to an end ; Sn 715 (~-sotassa bhikkhuno; Pj II 498, 10 : kilesasotacchedena ~-sotassa); 948 (~-soto abandhano; Nidd I 433, 18 : sotā vuccati taṇhā … yass’ esā sotā taṇhā pahīnā … so vuccati ~-soto); Ud 76, 27* (Ud-a 370, 19 : chattiṃsatiyā sotānaṃ anavasesato pahīnattā ~-soto nāma hoti); — neg. acchinna 2 , mfn. , not cut, not cut off; not stopped or dried up; continuous, uninterrupted ; Vin I 50, 11 (na ca acchinne theve pakkamitabbaṃ; Sp 981, 22 foll. : yadi appamattakaṃ pi rajanaṃ galati); III 51, 21 (dantapoṇaṃ nāma chinnaṃ vā acchinnaṃ vā); Ja II 78, 7* (atthi rukkhassa acchinnaṃ khajjataṃ yeva tiṇḍukaṃ; 78, 10´ : imassa rukkhassa phalānaṃ ākaḍḍhanaparikaḍḍhana-vasena acchinnaṃ bahuṃ ṭhānaṃ atthi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se acchinnabahukāraṃ atthi); Kv 243, 17 ; Vism 413, 19 (acchinnassa ca chedanato); Sp 768, 13 (acchinnattā); It-a I 107, 8 (saṃyojanāni acchinnāni); Th-a I 231, 5 (taṇhāsaṅgassa acchinnatāya); — acchinnagaṇanā, f. , counting in an unbroken series ; Ps II 56, 16 (gaṇanā ti acchinnagaṇanā, Ee so; Be, Ce acchidda-; Se gaṇanāyā ti acchiddagaṇanāya; = Nidd-a II 130, 26 : eds acchidda-); Sadd 803, 8 (gaṇanā ti acchinnagaṇanā, ekaṃ dve ti ādinā navantavidhinā nirantaragaṇanā ti attho; ≠ Ps-ṭ [ Be ] II 41, 26 : acchiddagaṇanā); — acchinna-dasika, mfn. [acchinna + dasika 1 ], with the ends (of the robe-material) uncut ; Vin I 311, 8* ( in uddāna: ~-dasikā; cf 306, 25 : acchinnadasāni cīvarāni); — acchinna-dhāra, mfn. [ from acchinna + dhārā 1 ], with an unbroken stream or flow ; Ja II 269, 10 (acchinnadhāre deve vassante) ≠ III 73, 12 ; Nidd I 42, 28* (yathā ninnā pavattanti chandena pariṇāmitā acchinnadhārā vattanti saḷāyatanapaccayā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se acchinnavārā, prob. wr ); Ps V 58, 6 (acchinnadhāraṃ katvā ākāsa-gaṅgaṃ otārento viya, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee avicchinna-vāraṃ); — acchinnadhārā, f. [acchinna + dhārā 1 ], an unbroken stream or flow ; Ja I 330, 21 (devo acchinna-dhāraṃ vassanto; or adv. to acchinnadhāra, raining with an unbroken stream ?); — acchinnasota, mfn. [acchinna + sota 1 ], having a continuous, unbroken flow ; Ud-a 370, 18 (pakatirathassa hi sukhavattanatthaṃ akkhasīsesu nābhiyaṃ ca upalittānaṃ sappitelādīnaṃ soto savanaṃ sandanaṃ hoti, tena so acchinnasoto nāma hoti); — succhinna, mfn. , well cut; properly cut ; Sp 1094, 3 ; — pp ( b ) chindita , mfn. and n. 1. ( mfn. ) cut, cut off ; Ps III 162, 7 (ekaṃ pattaṃ pi … ~aṃ vā khaṇḍitaṃ vā nāhosi); — 2. ( n. ) cutting ; S I 66, 6* (idha chinditamārite hatajānisu Kassapo na pāpaṃ samanupassati; Spk I 126, 18 : ~-marite ti ~e ca mārite ca); — ( c ) chijjita, mfn. , cut, cut down ; Ja III 389, 17* (so mato seti allapiṅkaṃ va chijjito, Ce, Ee so; Be vacchito; Se vicchito; 389, 21´ : chijjito ti chinno, Ce, Ee so; Be vacchito ti; Se vicchito ti vicchinno); — fpp ( a ) chejja , mfn. and n. 1. ( mfn. ) [ S. chedya], ( i ) to be cut; to be cut off ; Ja VI 536, 31* (~ā indīvarā; 537, 10´ : suvaṇṇa-indīvarā muṭṭhinā chinditabbā); Mil 83, 27 (ussahati ~aṃ chinditun ti); Ps V 97, 1 (kuṭhārī … ~aṃ chindati); — ( ii ) leading to the cutting off; leading to cutting off (from the saṅgha ) ;? Sp 905, 15 (kāyasaṃsaggo methunadhammassa pubbabhāgattā paccayo hoti iti ~ā siyā methunadhammapaccayā ti ettha iminā pariyāyena attho veditabbo, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~aṃ; ( or chejjā, f. ?) quoting Vin V 218, 35* : eds ~aṃ); — ifc see sīsa- ( sv sīsa 1 ); — 2. ( n. ) cutting; cutting off; cutting off of hands etc; cutting off from the saṅgha; Vin V 218, 22 (salākaṃ dentassa hoti ~aṃ; Sp 1393, 28 : salākaṃ pan’ assa dentassa hoti ~aṃ pārājikaṃ hoti); 218, 35* (~aṃ siyā methunadhammapaccayā; Sp 1394, 6 foll. : siyā methunadhammapaccayā pārājikan ti); Sp 1388, 13 (navasu janesu yo salākaṃ gāhetvā saṅghaṃ bhindati tass’ eva ~aṃ hoti Devadatto viya pārājikaṃ āpajjati); Spk I 61, 5 (~aṃ vā hotu maraṇaṃ vā); — ~-gāmi(n), mfn. [chejja + gāmi(n) 1 ], leading to cutting off from the saṅgha; Sv 100, 28 (ayaṃ āpatti ayaṃ anāpatti ayaṃ ~-gāminī ayaṃ vuṭṭhānagāminī); — ~-bhejja, n. , cutting and breaking; physical punishment ; Vin III 47, 2 (ye vā pana ~-bhejjaṃ anusāsanti); Ps III 415, 20 ; Thī-a 63, 25 (sattā kāmehi ~-bhejjaṃ pāpuṇanti); — ~-vatthu, n. [chejja + vatthu1], a ground for cutting off (someone) from the saṅgha; Vin III 109, 29* ( in uddāna: methunādinnādānaṃ ca manussaviggahuttari pārājikāni cattāri ~-vatthu asaṃsayā); V 216, 29* (āpajjeyya garukaṃ ~-vatthuṃ); — neg. acchejja 2 , mfn. , not to be cut, not to be destroyed ; Ja VI 226, 10* (satt’ ime sassatā kāyā acchejjā avikopino); Mp II 196, 14 (arahattamaggañāṇena acchejjānaṃ kilesānaṃ natthibhāvo); ( b ) chediya, mfn. , Kv 90, 13* (chinnassa chediyaṃ natthi); — ducchediya, mfn. , hard to cut ; Ja IV 483, 13´ (taṃ bandhanaṃ ducchediyaṃ hoti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ducchedanīyaṃ); ( c ) chijja 2 , mfn. , Ps IV 162, 1 (chijjesu pharasu viya kammaṭṭhāne manasikāro vahati); — ducchijja, mfn. , hard to cut ; Ps III 166, 18 ; ( d ) chetabba, chettabba, mfn. [ S. chettavya] Vin II 110, 24 (aññamhi … chetabbamhi aññaṃ chindi, Be, Ee so; Ce chettabbamhi; Se chinditabbamhi); Mil 293, 22 (so daṇḍāraho vadhitabbo chettabbo bhettabbo, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se chedetabbo); Vism 413, 18 (chinnassa puna chetabbābhāvato, Be, Ee so; Ce chedetabb-; Se cheditabb-) = Paṭis-a 366, 28 ( eds chettabbābhāvato); ( e ) chinditabba, mfn. , Mil 86, 14 (yaṃ kiñci chinditabbaṃ); Vism 122, 27 (dīghāni kesanakhalomāni chinditabbāni); Spk I 254, 13 (chinditabbaṃ) = Pj II 148, 29 ( Be, Se so; Ce chettabbaṃ; Ee chetabbaṃ); ( f ) chedanīya, mfn. , Peṭ 217, 10 (yaṃ tattha chedanīyaṃ ayaṃ nirodho, eds so, perhaps wr; Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 292 would read yaṃ taṇhāchedanaṃ); — ( g ) *chindiya; — ifc see ducchindiya; — caus. ( a ) pr. 3 sg. chedeti , ~ayati , cuts, cuts off; causes to cut off ; Ja III 179, 17* (hatthe me deva ~ehi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~ahi, mc ?); IV 372, 7* (na chindāmi na ~aye); V 448, 21* (chindeyyuṃ pi ~ayeyyuṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se chedāpeyyuṃ pi); VI 199, 17* (~ayissāmi te siraṃ; 199, 24´ : ~ayissāmī ti chindissāmi); Sadd 543, 30 (cheda dvedhākaraṇe: … ~eti ~ayati); — aor. 3 sg. chedayi, achedayi, Ja III 42, 6* (yo te hatthe … ~ayi); V 144, 3 (yo khaṇḍaso pabbajitaṃ achedayi); Mhv 35:43 (achedayi); 36:43 (~ayi); 1 sg. chedesiṃ, Ap-a 280, 6 (chindiṃ ~esiṃ); — absol. chedetvā, Th 512 (kesamassūni ~etvā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ); — fpp ( a ) chedetabba, mfn. , Vin I 50, 15 (na ekaccassa kesā ~etabbā, Be, Se so; Ee wr chedātabbā; Ce paṭiggahetabbā); 74, 9 (upajjhāyassa … sīsaṃ ~etabbaṃ); ( b ) cheditabba, mfn. , Kv 622, 12 (sandhi ~itabbā, Ee so; Be, Se ~itabbo); — caus. ( b ) pr. 3 sg. chedāpeti , ~ayati , Vin II 134, 19 foll. (cha-bbaggiyā bhikkhū kattarikāya kese ~enti … yo ~eyya); III 155, 34 (~essanti); IV 34, 28 (tumhe … rukkhaṃ chindatha ~etha pī ti); Ja V 439, 6 (sīsaṃ assā ~ehī ti); Mil 193, 11 foll. (hatthaṃ pi ’ssa bhante ~eyyāma, padaṃ pi ~eyyāma, yāva sīsaṃ kaḷīracchejjaṃ ~eyyāma, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se chindāpeyyāma); Sp 762, 23 (sayaṃ vā chindati aññena vā ~eti); Mhv 35:42 (~aya); — part.pr. ( a ) chedāpaya(t), mfn. , D I 52, 22 (chindato ~ayato); ( b ) chedāpenta, mfn. , Vin III 89, 30 (chindanto ~ento); M I 404, 30 ; — aor. 3 sg. chedāpesi, Vin III 155, 31 (āyasmā Channo … aññataraṃ cetiyarukkhaṃ ~esi); Mil 203, 17 ; — absol. ( a ) chedāpetvā, Vin III 43, 10 (tāni dārūni khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ ~etvā); A IV 274, 31 (Mahāpajāpati Gotamī kese ~etvā); Ja V 145, 25´ ; ( b ) chedāpayitvāna, Thī 98 (kese ~ayitvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ); — pp chedāpita, mfn. , (caused to be) cut or cut off ; Vin I 148, 23 (bhaṇḍaṃ ~itaṃ hoti); Vism 302, 33 ; — fpp chedāpetabba, mfn. , Vin I 50, 16 (na ekaccena kesā ~etabbā); II 134, 21 (na bhikkhave kattarikāya kesā ~etabbā); — caus. ( d ) pr. 3 sg. *chindayati, Ja V 337, 16´ (adhipātayissan ti chindayissam); — absol. chindayitvāna, Mhv 9:17; — caus. ( e ) pr. 3 sg. chindāpeti , ~ayati , Ja I 325, 28 (sīsaṃ ~essāmī ti); IV 30, 12 (imaṃ sūlaṃ cammasamaṃ ~ehī ti); Vism 190, 22 (yattha rājāno core ~enti); Sp 701, 7 (nahāpitena kese ~eti); Spk I 131, 22 (jivhaṃ pi ~eyya); — aor. 3 sg. chindāpesi, Ja I 455, 18 (nāsikaṃ ~esī ti); Sv 612, 28 (āyasmā Mahākassapo … suvaṇṇapaṭṭe akkharāni ~esi); 3 pl. chindāpayiṃsu, Ja IV 264, 23 (ambarukkhe ~ayiṃsu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~esuṃ); — absol. chindāpetvā, Ja II 197, 5 (~etvā); Spk I 264, 22 (rukkhaṃ ~etvā); — pp chindāpita, mfn. , Sp 1069, 25 (bhaṇḍaṃ chedāpitan ti … ~itaṃ).
